title.en: 2.1 Assembly addressing modes with valid examples
title.gu: 2.1 Assembly Addressing modes તથા Valid examples

h.en: Assembly addressing modes with valid examples
h.gu: Assembly Addressing modes તથા Valid examples

body.en:
Definition

An addressing mode specifies how an instruction obtains its operand or effective address.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Immediate:MOV A,#25Hloads the constant25H.Direct:MOV A,30Hreads internal byte30H.Register:MOV A,R2 reads the selected bank’s R2.
  • Register-indirect:MOV R0,#30Hfollowed by MOV A,@R0 reads internal RAM through R0.Indexed:MOVC A,@A+DPTR reads a code-table byte at16-bit DPTR plus8-bit Aoffset.
  • MOVX A,@DPTR reads external data,not code Flash;MOVC is not an external-data write command.Destination/source forms are instruction-specific:an arbitrary pair of operands is not always legal.
  • Bit operands such as SETB P1.0address a bit-addressable location;relative branch addressing uses a signed displacement within the instruction’s range.Check assembler diagnostics instead of guessing syntax.
Clear carry before SUBB why?

SUBB subtracts incoming CYas borrow as well as the operand.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Addressing mode instruction operand કે effective address ક્યાંથી મેળવે તે બતાવે છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Immediate:MOV A,#25H constant25H આપે.Direct:MOV A,30H internal byte30H વાંચે.Register:MOV A,R2 selected bankનું R2 વાંચે.
  • Register-indirectમાં MOV R0,#30H પછી MOV A,@R0થી R0 મારફતે RAM વાંચાય.Indexed MOVC A,@A+DPTR 16-bit DPTR તથા8-bit A offsetથી code table વાંચે.
  • MOVX A,@DPTR external data વાંચે,code Flash નહીં;MOVC external-data write નથી.દરેક instructionમાં arbitrary operands જોડીને valid instruction બનતું નથી.
  • SETB P1.0 જેવી bit instruction bit-addressable location વાપરે;relative branch signed displacement/range વાપરે.Syntax અનુમાનવાને બદલે assembler diagnostics જુઓ.
SUBB પહેલાં Carry clear કેમ?

SUBB operand સાથે incoming CYને borrow તરીકે બાદ કરે.

h.en: Assembly structure,directives and a traced program

body.en:
Definition

An assembler directive instructs the assembler how to organise symbols or output;it is not normally a CPU instruction executed as an opcode.

Explanation,application and checks

  • ORGsets an assembly location;EQUdefines a symbolic constant;DBemits data bytes;ENDends source processing.Segments/linker rules depend on the assembler,so Keil A51 and SDASsyntax are not identical.
  • Reserve reset/vector space;ORG0000H,LJMP START,ORG0030H,START:...is a simple absolute teaching layout,not a universal relocatable-project layout.
  • Trace:MOV A,#25H;ADD A,#17H;MOV P1,A;HERE:SJMP HERE gives A=P1=3CHand CY=0 for these operands.The loop holds the result for a simulator watch window.
  • Labels mark addresses,comments explain intent and a symbol table/map identifies placement.Never treat ORGor END as time-consuming CPU operations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Assembler directive symbols/output કેવી રીતે ગોઠવવા તે assemblerને કહે;તે સામાન્ય રીતે CPUએ ચલાવવાની opcode instruction નથી.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • ORG location,EQU symbolic constant,DB data bytes અને END source end બતાવે.Segments/linker rules assembler મુજબ બદલાય;Keil A51/SDAS syntax સમાન નથી.
  • Reset/vector space reserve કરો;ORG0000H,LJMP START,ORG0030H,START:...simple absolute teaching layout છે,universal relocatable layout નહીં.
  • Trace:MOV A,#25H;ADD A,#17H;MOV P1,A;HERE:SJMP HEREથી A=P1=3CH/CY=0 મળે.Loop simulator watchમાં result રાખે.
  • Labels addresses બતાવે,comments intent તથા symbol/map placement સમજાવે.ORG/ENDને CPU time લેતી operations નમાનો.

body.en:
Definition

A data-transfer instruction copies a value while an arithmetic instruction computes a result and changes only the flags specified for that instruction.

Explanation,application and checks

  • MOVcopies without deleting the source.ADDadds operand to A;ADDCincludes incoming carry.For plain subtraction clear carry then use SUBB A,operand;SUBB always subtracts incoming CYtoo.
  • INCand DECchange by one and wrap in the operand width;they do not update CYfor carry/borrow.MUL ABgives low product in A,high in B;DIV ABgives quotient A,remainder Bwhen B≠0.
  • For25/4(decimal),quotient6 and remainder1;division by zero is invalid and must be guarded in C.Donot read decimal25as25Hwithout conversion.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Data-transfer instruction value copy કરે;arithmetic instruction result ગણે અને તે instruction માટે specified flags જ બદલે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • MOV source delete કર્યા વિના copy કરે.ADD operandને Aમાં ઉમેરે;ADDC incoming carry પણ ઉમેરે.Plain subtraction પહેલાં carry clear કરી SUBB A,operand લો;SUBB incoming CY પણ બાદ કરે.
  • INC/DEC એકથી બદલે/width મુજબ wrap થાય;CY carry-borrow માટે update નથી થતો.MUL ABમાં low A/high B;B≠0 હોય તો DIV ABમાં quotient A/remainder B.
  • Decimal25/4માં quotient6/remainder1;zero division invalid છે/Cમાં guard જોઈએ.Decimal25ને conversion વિના25H નમાનો.

body.en:
Definition

A bit mask is a pattern used with bitwise logic to select,clear,set or toggle specified bits without intentionally changing unrelated bits.

Explanation,application and checks

  • ANL A,#0FHretains the low nibble;ORL A,#80Hsets bit7;XRL A,#01Htoggles bit0.Use complement of a mask to clear selected bits.
  • Awhole-port read followed by write can accidentally latch an externally low input as an output0.For mixed-use ports,use deliberate bit operations or a maintained output shadow with input bits held released.
  • Logical AND/ORin Cproduce truth values;bitwise AND/ORoperate per bit.Replacing &with &&in a register mask changes meaning even when both compile.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Bit mask bitwise logicથી ચોક્કસ bits select,clear,set/toggle કરવા માટેની pattern છે,બીજા bitsને ઇરાદાપૂર્વક નબદલતાં.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • ANL A,#0FH low nibble રાખે;ORL A,#80H bit7 set કરે;XRL A,#01H bit0 toggle કરે.Complement maskથી selected bits clear કરો.
  • Whole-port read/writeથી externally low input output0 તરીકે latch થઈ શકે.Mixed-use portમાં bit operation કે input bits release રાખતો output shadow વાપરો.
  • Cમાં logical AND/OR truth value આપે;bitwise AND/OR દરેક bit પર કામ કરે.Register maskમાં &ને &&થી બદલતાં અર્થ બદલાય,ભલે compile થાય.

title.gu: 2.2 Assembly language તથા Embedded Cનો ભેદ

h.gu: Assembly language તથા Embedded Cનો ભેદ

body.en:
Definition

Assembly expresses target instructions and registers directly;Embedded Cexpresses algorithms in a Cimplementation with target-specific hardware extensions and a compiler-generated instruction sequence.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Assembly offers explicit instruction control but is target-specific and harder to maintain.Csupports structured logic,functions and reusable modules,but generated timing/size depend on compiler and optimisation.
  • Cis not automatically portable when code uses sbit,sfr,code,interruptor chip-specific headers.Hardware abstraction improves portability,but pin maps and peripheral configuration still need adaptation.
  • Neither language prevents electrical damage or logical race conditions.Verify emitted code for timing-sensitive work and use measured/simulated results with their true scope.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Assembly target instructions/registers સીધા વ્યક્ત કરે;Embedded C algorithms તથા target-specific extensions વાપરે અને compiler instruction sequence બનાવે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Assembly explicit instruction control આપે પણ target-specific/maintain કરવી મુશ્કેલ છે.Cમાં structured logic/functions/modules સરળ છે,પણ timing/size compiler/optimisation મુજબ બદલાય.
  • sbit,sfr,code,interrupt તથા chip headers વાપરતું C આપોઆપ portable નથી.Hardware abstractionથી portability સુધરે,પણ pin/peripheral adaptation જોઈએ.
  • કોઈ language electrical damage/race આપોઆપ અટકાવતી નથી.Timing-sensitive codeનું emitted listing તપાસો;measured/simulated resultનો scope સાચો લખો.

title.en: 2.3 Embedded Cprogram structure and tool setup
title.gu: 2.3 Embedded C Program structure તથા Tool setup

h.en: Embedded Cprogram structure and tool setup
h.gu: Embedded C Program structure તથા Tool setup

body.en:
Definition

An Embedded Cprogram combines declarations,initialisation and control functions with target headers that name the hardware registers.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Keil C51 examples use#include<reg51.h>,sbitdeclarations,helper functions and void main(void){initialise;for(;;){task;}}.Aheader declares hardware names;it does not physically connect a device.
  • Use comments for pin polarity,clock,units and assumptions.Configure exact target/clock,build,review warnings,link memory map,then inspect HEXin a simulator before approved hardware download.
  • Keil C51 syntax differs from SDCC:#include<8051.h>,__sbit __at(...),__interrupt(...).This package supplies adapted SDCC sources for local compile tests;that is not a claim of Keil/Proteus or real-board execution.
  • Classic AT89C51 usually needs its supported parallel programmer;AT89S51 and other derivatives use different programming interfaces.FlashMagic/JTAGfeatures in the resource list apply only to supported devices.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Embedded C program declarations,initialisation/control functions તથા hardware registersનાં નામ આપતા target headersથી બને છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Keil C51 examplesમાં#include<reg51.h>,sbit,helper functions તથા void main(void){initialise;for(;;){task;}} છે.Header hardware names આપે,device physically જોડતું નથી.
  • Commentsમાં pin polarity,clock,units/assumptions લખો.Exact target/clock configure કરી build,warnings/link map તપાસો,પછી simulator HEX અને approved download કરો.
  • SDCCમાં#include<8051.h>,__sbit __at(...),__interrupt(...) હોય;Keil C51થી અલગ છે.આ package adapted SDCC sourceથી local compile કરે;Keil/Proteus/real-board executionનો દાવો નથી.
  • Classic AT89C51 માટે સામાન્ય supported parallel programmer જોઈએ;AT89S51/અન્ય derivativeની programming interface અલગ છે.FlashMagic/JTAG માત્ર supported devices માટે છે.

body.en:
Definition

A data type defines representation and permitted operations;Keil C51 bitis a bit-storage type,sbitdeclares a named absolute hardware bit,and they are not interchangeable general byte types.

Explanation,application and checks

  • C51 char/unsigned charare8-bit;int/unsigned intare16-bit.In these notes use unsigned charfor0..255 and unsigned intfor0..65535;plain charsignedness is compiler-option dependent,so state it explicitly.
  • sbit LED=P1^0;names the bit P1.0;it does not mean XORassignment at runtime.The declaration must use the compiler-supported absolute-bit syntax.bit flag;allocates a bit variable,not an arbitrary peripheral pin.
  • Widen before arithmetic when a larger result is required:unsigned int sum=(unsigned int)a+b.For multiplication cast before a*b;otherwise an intermediate can overflow even if the final destination is larger.
  • volatiletells the compiler a value can change unexpectedly;it does not make a16-bit read/write atomic on an8-bit CPU.Protect shared multi-byte access with an appropriate critical section.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Data type representation/operations નક્કી કરે;Keil C51નું bit bit-storage type છે,sbit named absolute hardware bit જાહેર કરે;તે general byte types નથી.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • C51 char/unsigned char8-bit અને int/unsigned int16-bit છે.અહીં unsigned char0..255 તથા unsigned int0..65535 માટે છે;plain char signedness option-dependent હોવાથી explicit લખો.
  • sbit LED=P1^0; P1.0નું નામ આપે;runtime XOR assignment નથી.Compiler-supported syntax જોઈએ.bit flag; bit variable allocate કરે,arbitrary peripheral pin નહીં.
  • મોટો result જોઈએ તો arithmetic પહેલાં widen કરો:unsigned int sum=(unsigned int)a+b.Multiplication પહેલાં cast કરો;મોટી destination હોવા છતાં intermediate overflow થઈ શકે.
  • volatile unexpected change જણાવે;8-bit CPUમાં16-bit read/write atomic બનાવતું નથી.Shared multi-byte access માટે યોગ્ય critical section જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

Arithmetic operators calculate numeric results;logical operators combine truth conditions;bitwise operators transform individual bits of integer representations.

Explanation,application and checks

  • +,-,*,/,%are arithmetic;&&,||,!are logical;&,|,^,~,<<,>>are bitwise/shift operators.Assignment=differs from equality==.
  • If x=0x80,y=0x01:bitwise x&y=0but logical x&&y=1because both are nonzero.Integer division discards the fractional part for these positive integer examples.
  • Use unsigned operands for predictable masks/shifts and keep shift counts within type width.Parenthesise register tests:(P1&0x01)==0,rather than relying on tricky precedence.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Arithmetic numeric result ગણે;logical truth conditions જોડે;bitwise integer representationનાં individual bits બદલે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • +,-,*,/,% arithmetic;&&,||,! logical;&,|,^,~,<<,>> bitwise/shift છે.Assignment= તથા equality== અલગ છે.
  • x=0x80,y=0x01 હોય તો x&y=0,પણ x&&y=1 કારણકે બંને nonzero છે.Positive integer divisionમાં fractional part છૂટી જાય.
  • Masks/shifts માટે unsigned operands અને type-widthની અંદર shift count લો.Register test (P1&0x01)==0 તરીકે parenthesise કરો,precedence પર અંદાજ નલગાવો.

body.en:
Definition

A control statement selects or repeats execution according to a condition;correct loop bounds and update rules are part of the program’s correctness.

Explanation,application and checks

  • if-elseselects between conditions;switchselects cases and breakprevents unintended fall-through.forand whiletest before a repeated body;do-whileexecutes the body at least once.
  • Anunsigned charloop for(i=0;i<256;i++)never terminates as intended because iwraps0..255.Use a16-bit index or another valid bound;similarly avoid unsigned reverse loops with i>=0.
  • Anempty delay loop can be removed by optimisation;volatileonly prevents certain removal and does not calibrate elapsed time.Use timers for specified delays and keep blocking demonstrations separate from responsive control firmware.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Control statement condition મુજબ execution પસંદ/repeat કરે;loop bounds/update rules correctnessનો ભાગ છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • if-else conditions પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરે;switch cases પસંદ કરે/break unintended fall-through રોકે.for/while body પહેલાં test કરે;do-while ઓછામાં ઓછું એકવાર body ચલાવે.
  • unsigned char માટે for(i=0;i<256;i++) intended રીતે પૂરું નથી થતું કારણકે i0..255માં wrap થાય.16-bit index/valid bound લો;unsigned reverse loopમાં i>=0 ટાળો.
  • Empty delay loop optimisationથી દૂર થઈ શકે;volatile થોડું removal રોકે,elapsed time calibrate નથી કરતું.Specified delay માટે timer અને responsive firmwareથી blocking demo અલગ રાખો.

body.en:
Definition

A correct arithmetic program specifies operand width,signedness,overflow/borrow policy and output representation before calculating.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Addition250+10=260needs16-bits;low-byte port output is04Hwhile the high byte is01H.Subtraction10−25can be represented as modulo8-bit F1Hwith borrow or signed−15;state the policy.
  • Multiplication25×12=300=012CHrequires high and low bytes.Division25/4 gives quotient6 and remainder1;check divisor0before division and preserve an error status.
  • Practicals1–4use P1/P0/P2/P3 as source-specified simulator output registers,not simultaneous external-device wiring.P0 needs pullups only if physical HIGH outputs are actually used.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

સાચા arithmetic programમાં ગણતરી પહેલાં operand width,signedness,overflow/borrow policy તથા output representation નક્કી થાય.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • 250+10=260 માટે16-bits જોઈએ;port low byte04H/high byte01H.10−25ને modulo8-bit F1H/borrow અથવા signed−15 તરીકે બતાવી શકાય;policy લખો.
  • 25×12=300=012CH માટે high/low bytes જોઈએ.25/4માં quotient6/remainder1;division પહેલાં divisor0 તપાસી error status રાખો.
  • Practicals1–4માં P1/P0/P2/P3 source મુજબ simulator output registers છે,એકસાથે external wiring નહીં.Physical HIGH માટે P0ને pullups જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

A function is a named callable unit that performs a defined operation through parameters,return value and specified side effects.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Separate gpio_init,read_switch,adc_read,lcd_write and control_stepaccording to their responsibilities.Pass units/types explicitly and avoid hidden shared port writes.
  • For a12MHz12Ttimer,one count=1µs;using Timer0 Mode1 for1msneeds1000 counts and preload65536−1000=64536=FC18H.Delayfunctions in examples use this nominal interval and incur software overhead.
  • Document which timer a function owns;calling a Timer0 delay inside another Timer0 ISR or a UART using Timer1 without coordination breaks the design.Many 8051 Cfunctions are not reentrant by default.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Function named callable unit છે,જે parameters,return value તથા specified side effectsથી defined operation કરે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • gpio_init,read_switch,adc_read,lcd_write/control_step અલગ જવાબદારી મુજબ ગોઠવો.Units/types explicit રાખો;hidden shared-port writes ટાળો.
  • 12MHz12T timerમાં count=1µs;Timer0 Mode1થી1ms માટે1000 counts/preload65536−1000=64536=FC18H.Example delay nominal છે/software overhead ઉમેરાય.
  • Function કયો timer વાપરે તે લખો.Timer0 ISRમાં Timer0 delay કે coordination વિના UARTનું Timer1 બદલવાથી design બગડે.ઘણી8051 C functions default reentrant નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Port configuration means assigning functions and establishing latch/direction-equivalent states and output polarity before reading or driving a signal.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Example active-low LED on P1.0 uses an approved resistor/driver arrangement:0=ON,1=OFF.Active-low switch on P3.2must be released by writing1before reads;do not enable INT0 unless that function is intended.
  • Always initialise the safe output state before enabling a load driver.Debounce by stable samples or a time-based state machine;raw switch bounce is not multiple genuine presses.
  • The dedicated firmware/practical cards include complete C51 source,pin maps,expected logical results and blank actual records;they are not claims of hardware testing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Port configuration એટલે function assignment તથા signal વાંચતાં/ચલાવતાં પહેલાં latch,direction-equivalent state/output polarity ગોઠવવી.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • P1.0 પર approved resistor/driverવાળી active-low LEDમાં0=ON/1=OFF.P3.2 switchને read પહેલાં1લખી release કરો;જરૂર ન હોય તો INT0 enable નહીં.
  • Load driver enable પહેલાં safe output initialise કરો.Stable samples/time-stateથી debounce કરો;raw bounce અનેક સાચા presses નથી.
  • Dedicated firmware/practical cardsમાં full C51 source,pin maps,expected logical results/blank records છે;hardware testingનો દાવો નથી.

title.en: Practical.3 3. Multiplication of two numbers at Port2
title.gu: Practical.3 3. બે સંખ્યાનો ગુણાકાર Port2 પર

h.en: 3. Multiplication of two numbers at Port2

body.en:
Aim and status

A source-listed laboratory guide for authorised simulation/trainer work;it is not a claim of performed measurements.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Suggested duration2h;source compulsoryyes.Source Unit/COentry2is retained even if theory placement differs.
  • Simulator/watch only:P2,product and high_byte;do not attach an LCD or external bus for this exercise.
  • 25×12=300=012CH;P2=2CH,high_byte=01H.
  • Resources:exact 8051 trainer or target simulator,correct programmer/headers,isolated current-limited supply and required approved instruments/components;check datasheets and reset-safe driver gating before power.
